decision_conditions: The proposed side extension incorporating side dormer by reason of the size, siting and design would unbalance the appearance of the pair of semi-detached dwellings and appear bulky and incongruous, and would represent an overly dominant, incongruous and visually intrusive form of roof addition out of keeping and character with, and detrimental to the appearance and character of the host property and surrounding area.  The proposals are thereby contrary to Policies D3 of the London Plan (2021), Core Strategy (2010) Policy CP30 and Development Management Document (2014) Policies DMD8, DMD13, DMD14 and DMD37 and National Planning Policy Framework (2024).
description: Variation of condition 2 of reference 25/02108/HOU to allow change to front bay window to ground and first floor and side dormer to accommodate new staircase.
